title: Add nonconvergence and fallback behavior

scope.assurance_scope: PCSM Python-v1 nonconvergence and fallback capability assessment for the exact current admitted source forest
scope.implementation_delta: Reuse current-head LogicPredictionCEGIS@1 rather than introduce a PCSM wrapper, a second refinement loop, or a separate fallback authority. The versioned controller detects repeated state, cycles, no progress, cancellations, timeouts, and bounded-resource exhaustion; it emits a deterministic terminal receipt plus typed residual feedback for Tactician. Raw solver material stays diagnostic-only, and neither the fallback nor a test result can mutate source, promote a result, or grant completion.

selected_existing_authority.minimum_delta_reason: PCSM-075 already selected LogicPredictionCEGIS@1 as the smallest bounded refinement authority. Its closed terminal reason/disposition contracts and TacticianResidualFeedback@1 already supply the required deterministic nonconvergence and fallback behavior. A PCSM adapter, new fallback schema, or second state machine would duplicate authority and exceed this receipt-only dispatch.

components.role: Deterministic bounded controller that returns content-addressed terminal receipts, preserves originals/facets, detects nonconvergence, and fail-closes authority violations.
Closed typed terminals distinguish repeated state, cycle, no progress, bounds, resource exhaustion, cancellation, timeout, authority violation, and inconclusive result without a silent success path.
CID-bound explicit fallback packet for unresolved gaps, diagnostic countermodels, exclusions, query hints, reason codes, and stop reason; it does not itself prove, mutate, or promote.

determinism_and_binding.identity: State, rounds, terminal receipts, and residual feedback derive identities from canonical content. The direct suite verifies identity-equivalent deterministic replay and dictionary round trips.
determinism_and_binding.nonconvergence_behavior: Repeated state and cycles end as INCONCLUSIVE with residual feedback; progressing work that reaches a hard limit ends as BOUND_EXHAUSTED with residuals; cancellation is typed CANCELLED; invalid memory accounting fails closed as MEMORY_EXHAUSTED. Every terminal retains original goals and routes residual work explicitly rather than claiming refinement or silently retrying.
determinism_and_binding.authority_boundary: Raw solver countermodels may guide diagnostic retrieval only. Rejection/narrowing requires validated replay against originating LogicIR semantics or proof of negation. Model-proposed decomposition and unauthorized premises fail closed. The controller does not execute solvers, mutate source, admit predictions, grant completion, or promote results.

source_inventory.role: Current-head LogicPredictionCEGIS@1 implementation: versioned schemas, canonical identities, closed nonconvergence terminals, bounds, authority checks, and deterministic residual feedback.
Direct positive and negative tests for deterministic refinement, nonconvergence, bounds, cancellation, residual fallback, CID identity, and authority rejection.
Underlying module reached by the required PCSM suite; recorded separately and never relabelled as nonconvergence/fallback integration coverage.

focused_nonconvergence_and_fallback_vali.command: PATH=/usr/local/sbin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/sbin:/usr/bin HOME=<fresh ipfs-accelerate-validation-home-pcsm076-focused-*> XDG_CACHE_HOME=$HOME/.cache XDG_CONFIG_HOME=$HOME/.config XDG_DATA_HOME=$HOME/.local/share XDG_STATE_HOME=$HOME/.local/state PYTHONNOUSERSITE=1 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=ipfs_accelerate_py /usr/bin/python3.12 -m pytest -q test/api/test_agent_supervisor_logic_prediction_cegis.py
focused_nonconvergence_and_fallback_vali.environment: Authoritative sealed Python 3.12.3 with pytest 8.1.1, prescribed PATH, fresh private HOME/XDG root, user-site disabled, and accelerator source only on PYTHONPATH.
positive_coverage: Repeated states/cycles deterministically terminate with an INCONCLUSIVE receipt retaining residual gaps and Tactician feedback; max rounds produces BOUND_EXHAUSTED with residuals; cancellation returns typed CANCELLED with residuals.

State identity is monotonic and canonical, deterministic replay is identity-equivalent, round/state contracts round-trip, originals/facets remain preserved, and validated evidence can refine only within the versioned policy bounds.
negative_coverage: Invalid memory measurement fails closed as MEMORY_EXHAUSTED; counterexample caps are enforced; raw or cross-root solver material stays diagnostic-only; and diagnostic receipts cannot eliminate hypotheses.

Original goals cannot be dropped; model decomposition without authority, decomposition without a refinement proof, unauthorized premise addition, and re-adding excluded premises are rejected rather than falling through to success.
focused_nonconvergence_and_fallback_vali.scope_limit: These are controlled generic LogicIR/controller fixtures. They establish the reusable nonconvergence/fallback contract only; they do not run a current-PCSM source-map-bound campaign, solver, or proof.
